description: Move files that arrived in this node's Taildrop inbox into a directory (`tailscale file get`).

conflict.description: What to do when a same-named file exists: `skip` (default), `overwrite`, or `rename`.

directory.description: Absolute directory that receives the inbox files.

wait.description: Wait for at least one file to arrive before returning.

ok.description: True when the CLI exited successfully.
